chunks: 2508 - The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said to ʿAlī عليه السلام: “O ʿAlī, when you alight at a place, then say:
O Allah, “Set me down in a blessed lodging, and You are the best of those who bring down to lodgings.”
You will be granted its good, and its evil will be kept away from you.”

key_terms.أَنْزِلْنِي: cause me to settle or lodge; asking Allah for safe placement
key_terms.اَللَّهُمَّ: O Allah; a direct invocation in supplication
key_terms.اَلْمُنْزِلِينَ: those who cause lodging or settlement; here referring supremely to Allah
key_terms.تُرْزَقْ: you will be provided sustenance or granted provision
key_terms.خَيْرَهُ: its good; the benefit and blessing of the place
key_terms.شَرُّهُ: its evil; the harm associated with the place
key_terms.مُبَارَكًا: blessed; filled with divine good and benefit
key_terms.مُنْزَلًا: a lodging place or place of settlement

ai.seo_question: What du'a should be recited when arriving at a place to stay?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a du'a to recite upon arriving at a place of lodging, invoking Allah for a blessed settlement. It connects the believer’s daily movement and travel to Qur'anic remembrance and trust in Allah, with the promise of receiving the place’s good and being protected from its harm.
